core_obligations: Sobriety: for a closed irreducible subset of the subset, the generic point of its closure in the ambient space lies in the subset, since otherwise a constructible set separating them would meet the closure in an open, contradicting the disjointness (proof lines 4651-4662)
Quasi-compactness: the subset is closed in the constructible topology, hence quasi-compact there and a fortiori in the induced topology (proof lines 4663-4669)

Basis and stability: the quasi-compact opens of the subset are exactly the traces of quasi-compact opens of the ambient space, they form a basis, and the trace of an intersection is the intersection of the traces (proof lines 4670-4674)
proof_roadmap: sober：取 E 中闭不可约 Z，令 η 为闭包( Z ) 在 X 中的泛点；若 η ∉ E，则由 E 在可构造拓扑中闭可取可构造 F 分离，而 F ∩ 闭包(Z) 含开集，与 Z ∩ F = ∅ 矛盾 ⇒ η ∈ E。
紧：E 在可构造拓扑中闭 ⇒ 在可构造拓扑中准紧 ⇒ 在诱导拓扑中准紧。
基与稳定性：E 的准紧开集 = E ∩ U（U 在 X 中准紧开），构成基；且 (E ∩ U) ∩ (E ∩ U') = E ∩ (U ∩ U')。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a subset of a spectral space which is closed in the constructible topology is again spectral (author lemma at source lines 4643-4649, label lemma-spectral-sub). The proof (source lines 4651-4675) proves sobriety through the generic point of a closure, obtains quasi-compactness from closedness in the constructible topology and identifies a basis of quasi-compact opens with the traces of quasi-compact opens of the ambient space (proof lines 4651-4674). The sobriety step and the description of the basis are the substance. H3.
